prompt: What are the lyrics to the popular, unofficial fight song of the university that the main character of Gilmore Girls attended?
answer:
The song is **“Boola Boola,”** Yale University’s popular unofficial fight song (Rory attended Yale). A commonly sung version is:

> There’s a school down East  
> Where the good folks go  
> To get a little knowledge.  
> And the name of this school  
> Is Yale, Yale, Yale—  
> And the boys all yell:  
> **Boola, Boola! Boola, Boola!**  
> **Boola, Boola! Boola, Boola!**  
> **Yale, Yale, Yale!**

“Bulldog,” written by Cole Porter, is Yale’s **official** fight song.
